summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of CaptionCraft AI landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed (health check, real GPT-5.2 caption generation, MongoDB persistence, 422 validation for invalid category/tone/missing fields/short topic). Frontend: All navbar links, hero CTAs (smooth-scroll to #demo / #examples), Live Demo flow (typing topic, Radix Selects for Category/Tone/Length, Generate button with real AI response in ~5s, hashtags rendering), sample button pre-fill, Copy button click (no exception), Pricing/Final/FAQ CTAs, accordion expansion, all 5 footer links, and mobile responsive (hamburger open/close, stacked form) all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan context manager (non-blocking)
LiveDemo.jsx initial result state is preset to SAMPLES[0] which causes the result card to always show content; minor UX nit — but acceptable as it doubles as the 'examples' anchor section

CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec; browsers ignore credentialed responses. Set explicit origins or set allow_credentials=False (non-blocking for current public no-auth app)
seed_data_creation: None. Real LLM-generated captions were inserted into MongoDB 'captions' collection via the API during tests (verified persistence by querying by id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 landing sections, backend /api/captions/generate (gpt-5.2 via Emergent), and MongoDB persistence are working. Real LLM call for 'Morning yoga routine' returned a valid caption with proper #-prefixed hashtags within ~5s. data-testid registry at /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/landing.js is the source of truth. Clipboard copy in headless Playwright may not write to system clipboard but the button click itself does not throw; toast verification was inconclusive in headless mode but no JS errors occurred.
